title: No computer that computes only through matter will be conscious

statements.text: No computer that computes solely through matter will ever be conscious, whatever its complexity, architecture or speed. As computers pass the speed of the brain, this can be tested within about a decade of 2020.
statements.falsification_criteria: A computer that computes only through matter, built to exclude field interactions between its parts, shows the marks of consciousness.

sources.quote: no computer that computes solely through matter will ever be conscious, irrespective of its complexity, architecture or computational speed
Conventional computers will never be conscious.
